Name: Colored Redesigned Garden Pots
Author: BethKitten
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=5]Redesigned Garden pots in various colors for your farm.  I took the empty pot from crafting and turned it in to a garden pot. There are nine different colors to choose from.[/size][/font]

[font=Georgia][size=5]This is a Content Patcher mod so it should work with every game version so long as you have the Content Patcher mod installed.
[/size][/font]
[font=Georgia][size=5]To use this mod simply download and unzip to your mods folder.  Should there be any issues or if you want another color please make a post in the post section of this mod.[/size][/font]

[font=Georgia][size=5]

Mods included in photos:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Daisy's Earthy Recolor[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966]Stardew Foliage Redone - foliage only[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12186]IdaIda's Seasonal Gothic Buildings (for CP and AT) (Mobile Version)[/url]
[/size][/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13671][font=Georgia][size=5]Scoot custom four corners farm and tweaks[/size][/font][/url]
